name: Valheim Dedicated Server
description: Install the official Valheim dedicated server through SteamCMD and run the native Windows server executable directly. Server name, world, password, visibility, crossplay, and save interval are managed GameNode configuration settings.
known_limitations: Valheim accepts its server password only as a process argument. GameNode stores the password outside its API, audit, logs, diagnostics, and support bundles and inserts it into the child process argument list at start, but a sufficiently privileged local operating-system user can still inspect process arguments. This limit comes from the game and cannot be removed by GameNode.
Valheim refuses to advertise a public server without a password. Leave the password empty only for a private server that players join directly.

Valheim documents CTRL+C as the proper shutdown method. GameNode does not model console control events, so this template uses terminate as a bounded fallback and does not claim graceful-save semantics.

The upstream dedicated server also supports Linux, but this template advertises Windows only until the direct Linux executable, required environment, and shutdown behavior are independently acceptance-tested without invoking start_server.sh.
SteamCMD is used for initial installation only; automatic updates are not enabled.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the Valheim server list.

variables.name: World
variables.description: World to create or load inside the managed save directory.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Password required to join. Required for a public server.

variables.name: Public server
variables.description: List the server in the public browser.

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Run the server on the PlayFab crossplay backend instead of the Steam backend.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds.

variables.name: Server port
variables.description: Base UDP port. Valheim also uses the next UDP port.

requirements.description: This reviewed template currently declares the direct Windows launch only.
Managed SteamCMD with anonymous login is required for installation.

Valheim reads its server password from a process argument. GameNode keeps the value out of its own APIs, audit, logs, and support bundles, but local operating-system process inspection remains possible.

help.summary: GameNode installs Steam App 896660 and launches valheim_server.exe directly without executing the shipped batch file. Server name, world, password, visibility, crossplay, and save interval are edited in the server's Configuration tab.
notes: The save directory is fixed to the server-root-relative path data so worlds and permission lists stay within the managed server root.
Valheim uses the selected UDP base port and base port + 1.
Changing a managed setting requires a server restart before it takes effect.
